frozen: 2026-10-06 before any V2 full-graph conditioning; V1 failure preserved
decoder: Fixed mean(MBON12)-mean(MBON01); strict margins required. No decoder fitting or polarity/amplitude adjustment after results.
feedback: Same identified two-valence interface and five conditions as V1. Shuffled control is a bounded Fisher-Yates permutation conditioned on equal PAM02/PPL103 counts within each cue and phase; both population totals match informative exposure. Unknown chess outcomes are outside this counterbalanced association task.
acceptance: All six informative seeds must acquire and reverse strict correct choices with margin and phase improvement above tolerance and cross the ranking boundary. Acquisition/reversal effects must exceed absent/shuffled controls by one-sided sign-test p<0.05. Require exact persistence/reset/restoration, disabled invariance, per-population phase pulse counts, fixed wiring/nonplastic state and after-update resumability. Punishment-only comparison is descriptive, not a post-hoc gate. All preregistered gates required; preserve failures.
retention: Exact software persistence only; no biological elapsed retention or consolidation.
scope: Separate fresh-seed control-design follow-up. V1 failed its full gate because two acquisition shuffles reproduced informative feedback. No V1 gate is changed. Same inputs, dynamics, plasticity, readout, current, trial counts and acceptance thresholds. Exact cue/valence balance removes that control artifact; it is an engineered control, not biological learning dynamics. No chess or unfamiliar reasoning claim.

control.seedRule: seed XOR acquisition 0x45c1 or reversal 0x89a3; continuous LCG across rejected permutations
control.condition: each cue receives half PAM02, half PPL103 in each phase
control.selection: uses cue/channel counts only, never neural responses or experiment outcomes
